{"kind": "source_excerpt", "path": "Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean", "version": "v4.26.0", "text": "160: Get a list of original global variable names that are referred to in an
161: `old(...)` expression. Note that `expr` below should be normalized by
162: `normalizeOldExpr`.
163: -/
164: def extractOldExprVars (expr : Expression.Expr)
165:   : List Expression.Ident := match expr with
166:   | .const _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .op _ _ _ => []
167:   | .abs _ _ e => extractOldExprVars e
168:   | .quant _ _ _ tr e => extractOldExprVars tr ++ extractOldExprVars e
169:   | .app _ e1 e2 => match e1, e2 with
170:     | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ v _ => [v]
171:     | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, _ => panic! s!"Old expression {expr} not normalized"
172:     | e1', e2' => extractOldExprVars e1' ++ extractOldExprVars e2'
173:   | .ite _ c t e => extractOldExprVars c ++ extractOldExprVars t ++ extractOldExprVars e
174:   | .eq _ e1 e2 => extractOldExprVars e1 ++ extractOldExprVars e2
175: 
176: /--
177: Substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with `s`.
178: -/
179: def substOld (var : Expression.Ident) (s e : Expression.Expr) :
180:   Expression.Expr :=
181:   match e with
182:   | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
183:   | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substOld var s e')
184:   | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substOld var s tr') (substOld var s e')
185:   | .app m e1 e2 =>
186:     match e1, e2 with
187:     | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
188:       -- NOTE: We rely on the typeChecker to normalize `e` ensure that `old` is
189:       -- only used with an `fvar`.
190:       if x == var
191:         -- substitute, if should be substituted
192:         then s
193:         else e
194:     | _, _ => .app m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)
195:   | .ite m c t f => .ite m (substOld var s c)
196:                       (substOld var s t) (substOld var s f)
197:   | .eq m e1 e2 => .eq m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)
198: 
199: /--
200: For each `(var, val)` in `sm`, substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with
201: `val`.
202: -/
203: def substsOldExpr (sm : Map Expression.Ident Expression.Expr) (e : Expression.Expr)
204:   : Expression.Expr :=
205:   if sm.isEmpty then e else
206:   match e with
207:   | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
208:   | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substsOldExpr sm e')
209:   | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substsOldExpr sm tr') (substsOldExpr sm e')
210:   | .app m e1 e2 =>
211:     match e1, e2 with
212:     | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
213:       match sm.find? x with
214:       | some s => s
215:       | none => e
216:     | _, _ => .app m (substsOldExpr sm e1) (substsOldExpr sm e2)
217:   | .ite m c t f => .ite m (substsOldExpr sm c)
218:                       (substsOldExpr sm t) (substsOldExpr sm f)
219:   | .eq m e1 e2 => .eq m (substsOldExpr sm e1) (substsOldExpr sm e2)
220: 
221: /--
222: For each `(var, val)` in `sm`, substitute `old(var)` in each expression `es`
223: with `val`.
224: -/
225: def substsOldExprs (sm : Map Expression.Ident Expression.Expr) (es : List Expression.Expr) :=
226:   es.map $ substsOldExpr sm
227: 
228: theorem substsOldExpr_singleton: substsOldExpr [(var,s)] e = substOld var s e := by
229:   induction e <;> simp [substsOldExpr, substOld, Map.isEmpty, *]
230:   split <;> simp_all;
231:   simp [Map.find?]
232:   split <;> simp_all
233:   intro h; rw [Eq.comm] at h
234:   contradiction
235: 
236: theorem substOldExpr_nil: OldExpressions.substsOldExpr [] e = e := by
237:   unfold OldExpressions.substsOldExpr
238:   simp [Map.isEmpty]
239: 
240: /--", "truncated": false}

25:   `Stmt`. This proof will be re-done with a new small-step semantics in the near
26:   future.

28:   This file contains the main proof that the call elimination transformation is
29:   semantics preserving (see `callElimStatementCorrect`).

58:   PredDisjoint (CoreIdent.isLocl ·) (CoreIdent.isGlob ·) := by
59:   intros x H1 H2
60:   simp [CoreIdent.isLocl] at H1
61:   simp [CoreIdent.isGlob] at H2
62:   split at H1 <;> simp_all

67: createHavocs (a ++ b) = createHavocs a ++ createHavocs b := by
68: simp [createHavocs]

71: createFvars (a ++ b) = createFvars a ++ createFvars b := by
